distributionCaveats: The return basis carries only distributions the vendor served (Yahoo actions); completeness is unaudited for continuing names. High-yield financials are where a missing distribution matters most, so their stock returns are likely understated relative to total shareholder return.

Whole-entity accounting numerators over one issue's market cap (ISSUE_CAP_ACCOUNTING_PROXY) distort book/earnings ratios of financial holding companies, and ocfYield/ocfToAssets/accruals are not comparable for banks and insurers.

Several members changed names or structure (e.g. Woori Financial Group relisted in 2019 under a new ticker; 053000.KS has no frozen accounting record); case studies cover each ticker's own history only.
No claim is made that these names are representative of financials or that financials differ from non-financials.

header.universeScope: SCOPE: point-in-time TOP-120 KRX market-capitalisation LARGE CAPS only (260 securities ever held that rank, 2013-2026). Nothing here describes the whole Korean market, mid caps or small caps.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Issue-cap accounting proxy: whole-entity book over one quoted issue's market cap. Preferred shares, holding-company structures and large minority interests distort it.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Book value of equity (total assets minus total liabilities, same statement, whole entity including minority interests) divided by the KRX market capitalisation at the signal close. Higher = cheaper relative to book. 순자산/시가총액: 높을수록 장부가 대비 저평가.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Same issue-cap mismatch as book-to-market; a one-off gain inflates it, a one-off loss deflates it.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Trailing-twelve-month net income (당기순이익, whole entity) divided by KRX market capitalisation. Higher = more earnings per won of market value; loss-makers are negative. 이익수익률.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Cash flow timing (working capital, capex-heavy cycles) makes a single TTM figure noisy.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Trailing-twelve-month operating cash flow (영업활동현금흐름) divided by KRX market capitalisation. Higher = more operating cash per won of market value. 영업현금흐름 수익률.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Banks and other balance-sheet-heavy firms have structurally small ratios; identical numbers mean different things across company types.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Trailing-twelve-month net income divided by total assets: a return-on-assets style profitability measure. Higher = more profitable per won of assets. 총자산순이익률.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Financial companies' operating cash flow is not comparable with industrial companies'.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Trailing-twelve-month operating cash flow divided by total assets. Higher = more operating cash generated per won of assets. 총자산영업현금흐름.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Large positive values can reflect depreciation-heavy or financing-linked cash flows, not only 'better earnings quality'.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: (Operating cash flow minus net income) divided by total assets. Higher = profit more fully backed by cash (lower accruals); lower = profit that has not yet become cash. 발생액(음수) / 총자산.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Measured on the same adjusted-index basis as the outcome (dividends included only where the vendor served them).
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: The stock's adjusted-index return minus the KODEX 200 benchmark's over the 126 sessions ending at the signal close: the prior benchmark-relative run-up (higher) or slide (lower). 직전 126거래일 벤치마크 대비 상대수익률.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Overlaps in time with relative126; the two are related but not identical.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Stock adjusted-index return from 252 sessions ago to 21 sessions ago (twelve-minus-one-month price momentum, skipping the most recent month). Higher = stronger prior trend. 12-1개월 모멘텀.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Structurally unobservable before 2018 under the frozen same-stage prior-year rule (fiscal-2015 interim filings lack the statement basis); coverage is reported per year.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: (Latest TTM operating cash flow minus the TTM one year earlier at the same reporting stage) divided by total assets. Positive = operating cash generation improved. 영업현금흐름 개선도.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Direction is inverted relative to the plain volatility number: a high value here means a quiet stock.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Minus the annualised downside semideviation (about zero, denominator all 126 sessions) of daily returns over the last 126 sessions. HIGHER = LOWER downside volatility (calmer). 하방변동성(음수): 높을수록 안정적.

labelsAndExecutiveMap.caveat: Liquidity versus large-cap / institutional / index-membership proxy cannot be separated by this variable alone; see the size and liquidity section.
labelsAndExecutiveMap.plainMeaning: Natural log of one plus the 60-session average KRX trading value (KRW). Higher = more liquid, which in a top-120 market-cap universe is also strongly associated with being larger. 60일 평균 거래대금(로그).
